## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? What's missing or awkward with the current API/behavior?

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature or API you'd like. Code sketches are welcome, e.g.:

```ts
board.nodes.create({ type: "...", /* ... */ });
```

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative approaches or workarounds you've considered, and why they fall short.

## Scope

- [ ] This fits within the flat-document model (see [product goals & scope](https://github.com/xindong/pixiboardSDK/blob/main/docs/00-product-goals.md)) — no nested scene graph.
- [ ] This is scoped to large/sparse/media-heavy canvas use cases, not general-purpose 2D graphics.

## Additional context

Anything else — related issues, prior art in other libraries, etc.
